strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. On the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then wait for price to retest the fair value gap and enter when the retest candle is engulfed in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target and otherwise do not micromanage the trade.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order on the fair value gap so that a pullback into it automatically enters the trade.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the first candle of the three-candle fair value gap pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target and otherwise let the trade play out without micromanagement.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct strategies: a scalping FVG retest-plus-engulfing entry with 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry variant with different timeframe structure and 2:1 target.
